**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (at/above the preferred position); no redline proposed.**

- **Direction.** All operative licence grants run *from* IBM as licensor to MSL: § 13.3(a) (royalty-free confidential-information licence to manufacture solely for IBM, p0208), Loan Agreement §§ 5–6 (p1530, p1532), and the Attachment 6 / Appendix A sublicensing prohibitions on MSL (p1301, p1337, p1346). Those are licensor-favourable to us and are not flagged.
- **Inbound position.** § 13.1–13.2 (p0197, p0198) give us outright **ownership plus assignment** of all IP in Product hardware, software, design and documentation and of MSL inventions on Products and IBM processes — stronger than any licence: perpetual, irrevocable, not revocable at MSL's discretion, transferable to successors, and usable by our contractors.
- **Affiliates.** "IBM" is defined at § 1.9 as IBM "and its Subsidiaries" (p0066), so affiliate coverage is already built in; adding an affiliates/written-notice mechanic would be duplicative.
- **Noted, not flagged.** § 24.1 states MSL conveys no licence under its own or third-party IP (p1136), and there is no standing licence to MSL background IP; exposure is contained by the bar on MSL using proprietary processes without written agreement and by the § 24.1(b) consent path. Minor, non-material — recorded in the rationale only.
